First, I count the number of distinct points in the path.  
The path has coordinates:  
1. (39.78,47.94)  
2. (27.24,37.07)  
3. (41.81,38.54)  
4. (36.74,32.11)  
5. (40.22,19.93)  
6. (46.25,27.14)  
7. (46.25,27.14) — repeated, but this is the start of the next segment  
8. (50.16,35.01)  
9. (46.02,45.07)  
10. (39.78,47.94) — back to start  

The path is drawn with lines between these points, but point 6 and point 7 are the same coordinate, so they count as one vertex.  
So vertices are:  
(39.78,47.94)  
(27.24,37.07)  
(41.81,38.54)  
(36.74,32.11)  
(40.22,19.93)  
(46.25,27.14)  
(50.16,35.01)  
(46.02,45.07)  
and back to (39.78,47.94).  

That’s 8 distinct vertices:  
1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 7 → 8 → back to 1.  

An 8-sided polygon is an octagon.  

Final answer: (F)
